silhouette.reason: Slab with ring footings, a sheer-legs hoist over one footing, tarped block piles, standing banner, setting-out posts with lines, timber stack and barrow: the sheer-legs now give FRONT and SIDE a strong vertical, so the build site reads from every view.
fixes: a second, lower vertical (stacked pallets or a ladder) on the opposite corner to balance the FRONT outline

proportions.reason: 17.2 x 19.4 x 3.6 m; piles, timber stack and footings at true scale; the team chevron is now laid as individual painted flags, smaller in TOP.
fixes: shrink the chevron another ~30% so it reads as a site mark, not a helipad

materials.reason: The floor is now a flagstone strip with readable joints and per-flag value (sheet TOP), no longer the camouflage slab. The chevron is broken up flag by flag. Tarps are still flat saturated red boxes with a white stripe, not cloth.
fixes: tarp cloth with value folds and lower saturation where it is sun-bleached
a rougher, dusty face on the footing blocks

detail.reason: Tarps on piles, string lines between stakes, wheelbarrow, mortar tub, timber stack, block courses on the footings, steps. Tarps are boxes with folds rather than draped cloth; no tools on the slab.
fixes: tarp edges hanging down the pile sides with a sag (site.ts materials())
a shovel and a hod leaning on one pile

wear.reason: Dark mud pads under every pile and the tub, and pale barrow tracks across the yard now tell a working site; the slab itself carries no mortar splash.
fixes: mortar splash on the flags round the footings and the tub

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps slab tone, footings, sheer-legs, piles, tarps, banner, timber and chevron; only the flag joints and string lines go, invisible at RTS distance.
fixes: keep the string lines as one thin quad each at LOD2

technical.reason: QA PASS: 8.9k / 3.1k / 656 tris, 2 / 2 / 2 draws; one trim material + team slot, LOD2 well under 1k. LOD0 down ~2k.
fixes: spend some of the LOD0 savings on the fixes above (quoins, string course, gravel) instead of more blocks
